column1: # Korean grammar words, endings and particles. One line per word as written + part of speech:
# word <TAB> UD part of speech <TAB> senses separated by " | ".
# The file replaces Wiktionary's determiner, pronoun, conjunction, particle and
# auxiliary entries for every word listed here; content words stay, and a line
# with a content part of speech comes before Wiktionary's of that part of speech.
# Particles and endings are written as Wiktionary writes them, with hyphens
# (-이나, -었-): the analyzer (`context.analyzer` in language.toml) gives each
# morpheme its base form spelled so (`baseSpellings`), and finds its line by it.
# A form after a `/` finds the same line (-으려면 for -려면).
# Lines are for what Wiktionary lacks or explains only by naming a form.
# Wiktionary lists 저 "that" before 저 "I", and 제 and 내 only as allomorphs:
# 저는 and 제가 opened on "that, that thing".

column3: I, me (humble, polite speech: 저는 학생이에요, I'm a student) | that, that one (over there, far from both: 저게 뭐예요?, what's that?)
that (over there, far from both: 저 사람, that person)
I (humble; 저 before -가: 제가 할게요, I'll do it) → 저 | my (humble; 저의: 제 이름, my name)
I (나 before -가: 내가 할게, I'll do it) → 나 | my (나의: 내 친구, my friend)
or (사진이나 영상, photos or videos) | ... or something (커피나 마실까요?, shall we have coffee or something?) | as many as, a whole (세 시간이나, a whole three hours) | just (instead of something else)
called, as: names or quotes what precedes, with 하다 or 부르다 (이것을 김치라 한다, this is called kimchi) | because (it is), being (학생이라 바빠요, (I) am busy because (I) am a student)

called; (said) that it is: quotes what follows a noun (장점이라고 할 수 있다, (it) can be called an advantage; 친구라고 했다, (he) said (it) was a friend) | introduces a direct quote ("가자"라고 했다, (he) said "let's go")
called, named (데미안이라는 소설, a novel called Demian) | that is: links a noun to the noun it describes (사실이라는 것, the fact that it is true)
as for, what is called: names a topic in order to define or describe it (행복이란 무엇인가, what is happiness?; 친구란 그런 것이다, that is what a friend is)
if (it is) (사실이라면, if it is true; 나라면, if I were (you))
by (means of), through (제공함으로써, by providing; 대화로써, through dialogue)
from (a person, place or source) (친구로부터, from a friend; 지구로부터, from the earth)
or, such as: lists examples (사과라든가 배라든가, apples or pears and such)
as, according to, like (말대로, as (you) said; 마음대로, as one pleases; 순서대로, in order)
and, so: sets out a situation for what follows (비가 오는데 우산이 없어요, it's raining and I have no umbrella) | but, whereas: a contrast (작은데 무거워요, it's small but heavy)
..., though; well, ...: a polite ending that sets out a situation and waits for a reply, or softens what is said (좋은데요, it's good, actually; 그런데요, but...)
only if (가야 알 수 있다, (you) only know if (you) go) | must, have to: with 하다 or 되다 (가야 해요, (I) have to go; 하셔야 돼요, you need to do it)
only if; must, have to: -아야 after a stem ending in 아 (가야 해요, (I) have to go; 봐야 알아요, (you) only know by seeing) | hey, oh: calls someone by a name ending in a vowel (민수야, Minsu!)
(I) should, (I) will have to (살아야겠다, I must live; 봐야겠어요, I'll have to see)
if (you) want to, to (do): the aim a condition is for (가려면, if you want to go; 막으려면, to prevent it)
in order to, intending to: formal (말씀드리고자 합니다, I would like to tell you)
if (it is the case that): supposes something (간다면, if (you) go; 좋다면, if it is good)
if, when: spoken -면 (돌리면은, if you turn it)
that: quotes a statement to describe the noun after it (온다는 소식, the news that (he) is coming; 좋다는 말, the saying that (it) is good)
(oh,) ...!: a polite ending for what the speaker has just noticed or feels (맛있네요, it's tasty!; 덥네요, it's hot!)
..., you see: a polite ending that explains or gives the reason (바빴거든요, I was busy, you see)
(I found that) ...: a polite ending that reports what the speaker saw or felt (맛있더라고요, it was tasty, I found)
..., you know: a polite ending that reminds the listener of something they know or should agree with (알잖아요, you know that; 춥잖아요, it's cold, isn't it)
a gentle polite question ending: ...? (괜찮나요?, is it all right?)
shall I, shall we ...?: a polite question ending (갈까요?, shall we go?) | do you think ...? (있을까요?, would there be?)
as (you know, see): 아시다시피, as you know; 보시다시피, as you can see
while, at the same time: two actions together (음악을 들으면서 공부해요, (I) study while listening to music) | even though, while (알면서 모른 척한다, pretends not to know though (he) knows)
and: links actions or descriptions, mostly written (키가 크며 힘이 세다, is tall and strong) | while, at the same time (웃으며 말했다, said with a smile)

that ...: quotes a statement indirectly (간다고 했다, said (he) would go) | ..., they say: hearsay at the end of a sentence (비가 온다고, it's going to rain, they say) | (saying) that, because: the reason someone gives (바쁘다고 안 왔다, didn't come, saying (he) was busy)

-ly: makes an adverb of a verb or adjective (빠르게, quickly; 크게, loudly) | so that (잘 보이게, so that it can be seen well) | with 되다: come to, end up (doing) (알게 되다, to come to know) | with 하다: make or let (someone do) (웃게 하다, to make (someone) laugh) | at the end, in speech: (I) will ...; will you ...? (내가 하게, I'll do it)
(so) ...!: notes something just realized (벌써 왔구먼, so you're here already)
if one is to, to (do): a condition for an intended act (말하자면, so to speak; 가자면 멀다, it's far if we are to go)
as for (why, what) ...: raises a question one then answers (왜냐면, because; 뭐냐면, the thing is)
(that) intends to, (that) is about to (가려는 사람, a person who means to go)
and then, after (doing) (밥을 먹고서 나갔다, (he) went out after eating)

-을 수 있다/-ㄹ 수 있다/-을 수가 있다/-ㄹ 수가 있다/-을 수도 있다/-ㄹ 수도 있다
column3: can, be able to (갈 수 있다, (I) can go) | may, might (비가 올 수 있다, it may rain)

column1: -을 수 없다/-ㄹ 수 없다/-을 수가 없다/-ㄹ 수가 없다
column3: cannot, be unable to (믿을 수 없다, (I) can't believe it)
have no choice but to (기다릴 수밖에 없다, (we) have no choice but to wait)
(it) will probably ..., so / but: an expectation (비가 올 텐데, it'll probably rain, so ...)
become, get (after an adjective: 넓어지다, to widen; 좋아지다, to get better) | be done (passive, after a verb: 만들어지다, to be made; 쓰여지다, to be written) → 지다
be ...ing: an action going on (먹고 있다, is eating) | be in the state of (입고 있다, is wearing)
after (doing), and then (먹고 나서, after eating)
want to (가고 싶다, (I) want to go)
not (do, be) (가지 않다, doesn't go; 크지 않다, isn't big)
cannot, fail to (자지 못했다, couldn't sleep)
come to, end up (doing), get to (알게 되다, to come to know; 가게 되면, if (you) end up going)
make or let (someone do) (웃게 하다, to make (someone) laugh)
because (비가 오기 때문에, because it rains)
have (done) before (가 본 적이 있다, (I) have been there)
(spoken) and then, having done (사 가지고 왔다, bought (it) and came) | so, because (늦어 가지고, because (I) was late)
according to, depending on (규칙에 따라, according to the rules; 사람에 따라, depending on the person)
according to (a source) (뉴스에 따르면, according to the news)
about, regarding (그 문제에 대해, about that problem)
(a noun) about, on (역사에 대한 책, a book about history)
through, by way of (인터넷을 통해, through the internet)
centered on, around (서울을 중심으로, centered on Seoul)
by: the doer of a passive (사람에 의해 만들어졌다, was made by people) | owing to, due to
not only ... (but also) (한국뿐만 아니라 일본도, not only Korea but also Japan)
for example
besides this, in addition, apart from that
in a way, from one point of view
as it turned out, it turned out that
after that, then, next
to come to mind, to remember (그 사람이 생각이 났다, (I) remembered that person)
to influence, to affect (건강에 영향을 주다, to affect one's health)
-ic, -al: makes a describing word of a noun, used with 인 or 으로 (화학적, chemical; 자연적인, natural; 효율적으로, efficiently)
a respectful suffix for people: Mr., Ms., dear (선생님, teacher; 고객님, dear customer)
type, model, form (최신형, the latest model; 원형, the original form)
rate, ratio (성장률, growth rate; 비율, ratio)
world, circle, field (학계, academia; 생태계, ecosystem) | system (신경계, nervous system)
in terms of, from the standpoint of (역사상, in history; 법률상, legally)
sphere, zone (수도권, the capital region) | right (투표권, the right to vote) | ticket (입장권, admission ticket)
system (대통령제, presidential system) | agent, medicine (소화제, digestive medicine)
class, group of people (노년층, the elderly) | layer, stratum (지층, stratum)
per (1인당, per person; 시간당, per hour)
power, ability, force (경쟁력, competitiveness; 영향력, influence)
feeling, sense of (책임감, sense of responsibility; 자신감, confidence)
student (대학생, university student) | born in (a year) (90년생, born in 1990)
by, according to, each (연령별, by age; 지역별, by region)
around, about (a time) (3시경, around three o'clock; 1900년경, around 1900)

column1: ## Bound nouns and adverbs whose common use Wiktionary lacks

column3: place | situation, case | in doing, for (after -는: 만드는 데 쓰인다, (it) is used for making; 가는 데 한 시간 걸려요, it takes an hour to get there) | thing; what: makes a clause a noun
together (with) | like, as: after a noun or -와 (이와 같이, like this; 눈같이 희다, white as snow)
also | again | 또 다른: another (또 다른 문제, another problem)
once, one time | just, (give it) a try: with a verb (한번 해 보세요, give it a try) | sometime (when there is a chance)
not very, not much, not particularly: with a negative (별로 없었다, there wasn't much; 별로 안 좋아요, it's not that good)
less | not fully, not yet (덜 익은, not fully ripe)
total, in all (총 12명, twelve people in all)
as, the way (one does): after -는 or -ㄴ (하는 대로, the way (one) does; 본 대로, as (I) saw)
what (뭐 해요?, what are you doing?) | something (뭐 먹을래?, do you want something to eat?) | (filler) well, like, you know (뭐 그런 거, stuff like that)
something (뭔가 이상해요, something is odd) | somehow, kind of
uh, um: hesitating | oh!: surprise | yeah (casual yes)
ah, oh | uh, um: hesitating
now, from now on | (filler) so, well, and then (이제 뭐, so, well)
just, just now (막 도착했어요, (I) just arrived) | recklessly, wildly, any old way (막 먹다, eat anything) | (filler) like, you know
a little, somewhat (contraction of 조금) | please: softens a request (좀 도와주세요, please help me)
very, really (되게 좋아요, it's really good)
so, that's why | I mean, that is (그러니까 제 말은, what I mean is)
then, in that case | (그럼) of course, sure
still, even so, nevertheless
this (thing): spoken 이거
this (thing), as the subject: spoken 이게
this kind of, such: spoken 이런
like this, this way: spoken 이렇게
